pairs.title: Danish krone in euros
pairs.description: How many euros DKK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Danish krone.
pairs.source: Derived from Federal Reserve H.10 series DEXDNUS and DEXUSEU (FRED) on each trading day: € per DKK 1 = (US$ per DKK 1) ÷ (US$ per €1).

pairs.title: Danish krone in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars DKK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Danish krone.
pairs.source: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED series DEXDNUS) · noon buying rate, New York; 1 ÷ the published DKK per US$.
